Metadata.title: WorldGuess
Metadata.description: Explore the world in WorldGuess — a geography guessing game. Drop into street views, play with friends, and climb the leaderboards.

media.discoverBackground: A world map connecting destinations across the globe
media.discoverCharacter: A traveler holding a glowing map
media.competeBackground: A golden WorldGuess competition crest and leaderboard arena
media.competeCharacter: Two competitors facing off in a friendly challenge

footer.tagline:
Explore the world one guess at a time.
Play solo, challenge friends, and climb the boards.

explore.title: Explore the world
explore.description: Drop anywhere. Read the clues. Make your best guess.

discover.title: Discover new places
discover.description: Get dropped anywhere from the busy streets of New York to the beautiful beaches of Bali.

friends.title: Play with Friends
friends.description: Put your skills to the test against your friends and family. Create your own private party and play together.

compete.title: Compete against others
compete.description: Climb the leaderboard and prove your geography skills.
